openapi: 3.1.1
info:
  title: Bank Operations API
  version: 0.1.0
  license: { name: Apache-2.0, identifier: Apache-2.0 }
  description: Internal operations and money-changing contract.
servers:
  - url: /api/operations/v1
security:
  - bearerAuth: []
paths:
  /transfers:
    post:
      operationId: createTransfer
      summary: Submit an idempotent transfer request
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/TransferRequest' }
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Accepted for state-machine processing
          content:
            application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Transfer' } }
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem' }
        '409': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem' }
  /transfers/{transferId}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TransferId'
    get:
      operationId: getTransfer
      summary: Get transfer status
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Transfer state
          content:
            application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Transfer' } }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem' }
  /transfers/{transferId}/reversal:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/TransferId' }]
    post:
      operationId: requestTransferReversal
      summary: Request a maker-checker transfer reversal
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { type: object, required: [reason], properties: { reason: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 240 } } }

responses:
        '200': { description: Pending reversal }
        '409': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem' }
  /internal/monitoring/alerts:
    get:
      operationId: getMonitoringAlerts
      summary: Get active operational alerts
      responses:
        '200':
          description: No service-blocking alert is active
          content:
            application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/MonitoringAlertResponse' } }
        '503':
          description: A service-blocking alert is active
          headers:
            X-Alert:
              required: true
              schema: { type: string, example: EOD_FAILED }
          content:
            application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/MonitoringAlertResponse' } }
  /transfers/reversals/{reversalId}/approve:
    parameters:
      - name: reversalId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
    post:
      operationId: approveTransferReversal
      summary: Approve and post a compensating transfer
      parameters:
        - { name: version, in: query, required: true, schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1 } }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { type: object, required: [reason], properties: { reason: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 240 } } }
      responses:
        '200': { description: Compensating transfer posted }
        '409': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem' }
